name: Sign bytes with Ed25519
description: Sign exact bytes with a secret-backed Ed25519 key. No implicit hash or CAD3 conversion. Returns a detached 64-byte signature.

seed.description: Secret reference to a 32-byte hexadecimal Ed25519 private seed: s/NAME or <did>/s/NAME. Never pass a raw seed.

data.description: Native blob bytes. JSON/MCP callers pass hexadecimal (0x prefix recommended), or select encoding:utf8/base64 for text input. No implicit hash, CAD3 conversion or JSON canonicalisation.

encoding.description: Applies to string input only: hex by default (optional 0x prefix), or explicit utf8/base64. Native ABlob input is used directly.

accountKey.description: Native 32-byte Ed25519 AccountKey; JSON renders it as a 0x-prefixed hexadecimal string.

did.description: Ed25519 did:key for this public key.

signature.description: Native 64-byte detached Ed25519 signature blob; JSON renders it as a 0x-prefixed hexadecimal string.
